cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: No Trouble at All
cards.instruction: Remain gracious and accommodating while making your growing inconvenience impossible to miss.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your brother's place at dinner is approved. Please give him my pie; I'm delighted he can join us.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can I find you something else? You haven't eaten.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your concern is appreciated. Peas are approved; my breakfast was quite substantial, several hours ago.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll order a pizza for you. It takes forty minutes.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Pizza is approved, thank you. I'll keep everyone company while they eat; then you may all enjoy watching me begin when you've finished.

reason: Keep A gracious while granting B helpful proposals, making the accepted delay visible as a public reversal of who watches whom eat.
